new_results.statement: For rank-one physical pair P_h with nonzero eigenvalue theta_h and null vector w_h, R_h(p)=+/-theta_h a_h(n_h)_p, rho_h=|theta_h||a_h|||n_h||, det K=-theta_h a_h^2, and (|theta_h|||q_h||)^2=|theta_h|(|det K|+rho_h^2/|det K|).
If rho_h>0 then ||p_Q||inf <= 2^(13/4)e^(1/4)[2|theta_h|rho_h]^(-1/4), retaining arbitrary same-complement curvature.
If the maximal partner P1 row has an exact rank-one pair with |theta_h|>=kappa, then on P_1>5P/16, ||p_Q||inf < 2^(13/4)e^(1/4)[12/(5 kappa^2 |beta| mu^4 P)]^(1/8).
